preconditions.description: The number of servers n must be between 1 and 30,000.
The number of replication rules must be exactly 4 times the number of servers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n for a, b, c in rules)
preconditions.description: Each server number in the rules must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'NO' or 'YES' followed by a sequence of 4n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 4 * n for x in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: All numbers in the output sequence must be between 1 and 4n.

postconditions.expression: any(process_count(server) <= 9 for server in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: At no time should any server have more than 9 processes.
